title: Playboy April 1982 Mariel Hemingway Complete w/ Centerfold Ed Koch Tommy Lasorda
conditionDescription: Complete w/ centerfold. Covers clean and bright with light handling wear; spine intact. See photos.
descriptionText:
Playboy magazine, April 1982, original $2.50 cover price. Complete w/ Centerfold. Playmate of the Month: Linda Rhys Vaughn.

Cover features: Mariel Hemingway Gets Physical - exclusive photo session plus scenes from her film "Personal Best"; Playboy Interview with New York Mayor Ed Koch; Roger Kahn on baseball's Tommy Lasorda; Reagan's Coming War on Drugs; The Year in Music; Man and Woman, Part Four.

Back cover: Marlboro cigarette ad.

Adult collectible - sold to buyers 18+ only. See photos for condition. Ships in a plain, protective mailer.
